picks.catalyst: Sympathy move: Nvidia beat and raised (AI cloud rally)
picks.why: Nebius rents out Nvidia-powered AI computers, and Nvidia's huge beat and higher forecast last night lifted the whole AI-cloud group; it's a 'sympathy' move with no Nebius news of its own, so it can fade if Nvidia fades. Price not confirmed this morning - use the live quote.

picks.catalyst: Sympathy move: Nvidia beat and raised (AI cloud rally)
picks.why: CoreWeave is Nvidia's biggest AI-cloud customer and jumped with the group after Nvidia's strong results and .5 trillion backlog; like Nebius, it has no news of its own today, so treat it as following Nvidia's lead. Price not confirmed this morning - use the live quote.

picks.catalyst: Bounce: AI server rally + says its Juniper routers worked as configured
picks.why: HPE fell hard Tuesday, then this morning said its Juniper routers worked as the installer (L3Harris) set them up in an ongoing investigation, and it's also riding the AI-server rally after Nvidia; a bounce after a sharp drop can keep going, but the investigation is still open. Price not confirmed - use the live quote.

picks.catalyst: Gap down on weaker-than-expected annual forecast
picks.why: Dolby fell about 4% after hours Tuesday because its yearly forecast came in below Wall Street's estimates; a soft forecast hurts the mood but doesn't threaten the business, which is the kind of gap-down that can bounce once sellers are done. The -3.8% is the after-hours move, not a fresh pre-market quote - check it.

picks.catalyst: Earnings beat but profit outlook trimmed (gap down)
picks.why: Lowe's beat estimates and raised its sales forecast, but the beat was helped by a one-time tariff refund and it trimmed its profit-margin outlook, so the stock is down; that's a 'good company, disappointing details' drop that can reverse, but at -2.5% it's under the usual 3% bar - watch, don't force it.
